text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:

- Switzerland set December 1, 1996 as the date for voting on a new immigration law initiative. The proposed legislation, which has been promoted by the right-wing Swiss People's Party, includes tougher measures for prospective immigrants who enter the country illegally. The Swiss government have opposed the initiative, calling it counter-productive and ineffective.
- Car sales in Switzerland fell by 9.4 percent in September compared to the same month last year.

- The European Union officially submitted a new compromise to Switzerland with regard to the free-flow of persons in Europe. The E.U. compromise has been judged an important step towards Switzerland's demands on the issue.
